name: Do I need a building permit for a kitchen upgrade in the Denver metro area?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a building permit for a kitchen upgrade in the Denver metro area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Permits depend on project scope and your local municipality within the greater Denver area, including Aurora, Centennial, or Parker. Simple cosmetic updates like tiling a backsplash, replacing finish trim, or repainting walls do not require permits. However, removing load-bearing walls, altering structural framing, or running new plumbing lines and electrical circuits generally requires municipal permits and rough-in inspections before drywall can be closed up.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cosmetic changes do not require permits, but structural framing changes or new plumbing and electrical lines require city permits and inspections.
